stances.quote: President Trump‘s decision to gut joint military exercises with South Korea is dangerous. South Korea is one of America’s most critical allies in the Indo-Pacific. Reducing these readiness drills serves no legitimate national security objective; instead, it sacrifices vital military deterrence for short-term political posturing and transactional foreign policy.
stances.reasoning: The statement explicitly criticizes reducing military exercises as dangerous and lacking national security justification, indicating support for maintaining or increasing defense readiness.
